purpose: Calibration of broad source discovery. Research artifact only; no production/canonical mutation.

methodology.historical_methodology_preserved: Strict requires exact-city evidence, aerial-war context, one concrete frozen alert episode, and event timing inside that episode or explicit wording tying the event to that alert. Publication time alone is never event time. PVO alone is not explosion evidence.
methodology.discovery_then_adjudication: Vocabulary is a discovery mechanism, never a classification rule. Messages are assembled into attack chronologies/evidence chains before episode attribution.
episode_attribution_priority: contemporaneous live message timestamp when wording describes the event as occurring then
explicit wording tying event to the alert
methodology.multi_episode_rule: Generic 'during the alert' wording cannot choose among multiple same-day episodes without episode-specific timing. Such cases remain needs_review/episode_ambiguous.
methodology.delayed_publication_rule: A later article/update is assigned by stated event time/chronology, never by publication time.
methodology.pvo_rule: PVO_ONLY is discovery context, not strict evidence. PVO_PLUS_EXPLOSION can qualify when exact city, aerial context and target-episode timing are all supported.
methodology.positive_control_independence: A control counts as independently rediscovered only when it surfaced through the pre-specified broad date/pattern search without using its old source URL/publisher as the search key. Artifact-assisted recovery is recorded separately.

discovery_queries_pattern_families.execution_note: All 35 selected dates were evaluated against all four logical families. Web requests sometimes combined strike/impact and weapon-context vocabulary in one query; channel tags separate the evidence role.

repo_local_raw_telegram_archive.note: Recursive branch-tree inspection found Telegram audit tooling/data but no stored raw Zaporizhzhia historical Telegram archive.

source_coverage.rate_definition: Unique Slice 0 episodes with independently surfaced attributable evidence in the named discovery channel divided by 171. Channels overlap; rates do not sum to total source-hit rate.
